note: Maropitant is primarily available as a veterinary medication (Cerenia) for dogs and cats. It is NOT FDA-approved for human use in the United States. Human pharmaceutical variants in pill form are not available in the US market.
availability_note: Maropitant is available in the US only as a veterinary injection (IV, IM, SC) and veterinary tablets. No human oral pharmaceutical variants exist in the US market.
